recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a stale release-specific diff label reappears, fix the shared template or generator rather than an individual generated page.
issue_request: FHIR-35860 asked to correct a mislabeled NamingSystem diff tab from "R3 Diff" to "R4 Diff" and to make the change in the shared template so other resources such as ValueSet were addressed.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found. Commit 2c85eeddd68fed529dd6ef3ec7bb498bb3d3d5a1 changed the active resource template and global difference page from R3 wording to R4 wording before the issue was resolved; final R5 NamingSystem and ValueSet pages render "R4 Diff".
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini. Current resource templates now use the version-neutral "Version Diff" label and link to R5, R4, and R4B diff artifacts for the current R6 build. FHIR-39183 is the same tab-label typo for ElementDefinition and already has a combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: Made no source change. Current source and current CI no longer contain the erroneous "R3 Diff" label, and final R5 renders the requested "R4 Diff" label.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive ElementDefinition report of the same "R3 Diff" versus "R4 Diff" typo; already represented on the combined branch by afadd432dbe1e3115afd17736d2ffb36d94d1402.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request as a shared template tab-label correction rather than a NamingSystem model change.

evidence_items.summary: Current active resource templates label the tab "Version Diff".
evidence_items.learned: The current source has neither the stale "R3 Diff" label nor a misleading R5-only label for current multi-version diffs.

evidence_items.summary: NamingSystem appears in the active [resources] list.
